software_engineer.headline: Graduate with a placement year behind him
software_engineer.why: The industrial placement is the load-bearing entry on a UK graduate CV, so it is written like a real job with real outcomes. Notice that each project says what the stack was, which part he wrote and whether anyone actually used it — a repository link on its own proves nothing.

qa_engineer.headline: Twelve years, quality lead in medical software
qa_engineer.why: A senior QA CV argues for a quality strategy rather than a testing service: the release gates you own, the shift-left decisions, the team, and — in a regulated domain — the standard your test evidence has to satisfy under audit. IEC 62304 and a clean audit are worth more here than any tool list.
